critical_code_review_comments: Backend: extension.py correctly implements duplicate detection in priority order (naukri_profile_id → email → phone)
Backend: CompleteNaukriProfileInput Pydantic model handles all 60+ fields from Naukri profiles
Backend: build_complete_candidate() stores data in flat structure for MongoDB with nested arrays for experience/education/etc
Backend: build_complete_update() correctly updates only provided fields while preserving existing data
Frontend: NaukriProfileView.jsx uses tabbed layout with 6 tabs, proper data-testid attributes
Frontend: formatSalaryINR utility correctly formats Indian currency
Frontend: CandidateBankRecord Pydantic model uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') - extra fields from MongoDB are silently ignored in list API
Frontend: All three role pages (admin/recruiter/employer) have consistent Naukri badge and Full Profile button logic
